note: Scripted calls for bar.ts --multi-turn: fixed caller turns, generated replies, the director and deliberation running between turns. The last two replies of each call are scored. `context` facts arrive as a memory-recall note (formatRecall) at the start of the call; `callback` marks a call where something said early matters later; `localHour` places the call at that hour of the caller's day (zoneAtLocalHour). Insight is judged on calls with any of the three.
